title: Tobacco Cessation for Pregnant and New Mothers — Baby Bear Hugs — 589 Banner St - Elbert County
summary: Provides support to individuals who are pregnant and currently use tobacco or who quit within three months before or during pregnancy. A household member who uses tobacco may also enroll for quit support. Program features include:   Support for all forms of nicotine, including e-cigarettes and oral products  Services available up to 36 weeks into pregnancy  One-on-one counseling provided by certified counselors  In-person or telehealth appointments  Restricted gift cards to reinforce tobacco-free progress
